Finding: Unsafe cross-printer import/merge relationships
Impact: A new incoming history record can refer to an ID retained for a different printer; standalone validation also accepts log/task printer mismatches.
Recommended corrective action: Validate task → printer, log → task → printer and destination graph together. Offer explicit conflict resolution/remapping before one atomic commit.

Finding: Impossible usage states accepted from backups
Impact: Backups accept printer totals below completed readings or last-service baselines above current actual usage.
Recommended corrective action: Validate all usage/date relationships and monotonic readings before preview and commit; reject contradictory imports with row-level errors.

Finding: Verified FDM rule can be reassigned to resin
Impact: Changing only printerId retains Manufacturer Verified and the FDM procedure. Existing history remains on the original printer while the current rule moves.
Recommended corrective action: Prohibit reassignment after history or fork a new rule. Revalidate exact model/technology and invalidate unsupported manufacturer attribution.

Finding: Fixed-cadence interval edits reuse the wrong origin
Impact: Jan 31 origin advanced through June, edited from monthly to two-month cadence: offset resets and due date goes back to March 31.
Recommended corrective action: Preserve effective processed boundary and original recommendation separately; preview the new next due date before saving.

Finding: Scheduled rules accept backdated completion before latest service
Impact: A June 1 completion followed by a February 1 completion with unchanged cumulative usage is accepted, consuming another scheduled cycle.
Recommended corrective action: Validate latest completion/skip/reading date; provide a separate explicit audited correction mechanism if historical entry is needed.

Finding: Native future-year entry corrupts calendar DOM
Impact: Entering 2035 digit by digit passes through year 0203; unpadded generated dates produce duplicate NaN keys. Final grid retains 41 NaN cells.
Recommended corrective action: Pad/validate all generated dates and incomplete input, retain previous valid range, and test real segmented date controls and exactly 42 valid month cells.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.

Finding: Creator 5 profile is demonstrably incomplete
Impact: The bundled 500-hour procedure is accurate. The official maintenance index has 18 procedure links; at least the verified Y-axis usage-dependent monthly schedule is missing. Not all index entries are necessarily universal periodic tasks.
Recommended corrective action: Audit each official page for exact model/Pro applicability, conditions and documented interval. Show coverage and unresolved items; never invent intervals.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.
Phase3Status: PARTIAL — expanded verified text/guide coverage; video content, Pro applicability and ambiguous boundaries unresolved

Finding: Imported verification label is not substantiated
Impact: A package can declare Manufacturer Verified with blank source URL/date and changed intervals. The importer warning does not validate the resulting badge.
Recommended corrective action: Treat imported classifications as unverified assertions until official provenance is checked. Enforce required source/model/version fields and trustworthy review state.

Finding: New imported profiles are not independently usable as new models
Impact: Import installs data, but static manufacturer/model choices omit the new definition.
Recommended corrective action: Unify catalogue choices with installed/bundled registry entries, including technology and exact variants, without rebuilding application code.

Finding: Profile changes and applied documentation versions are misleading
Impact: Existing rules/logs are preserved, but incoming intervals are not displayed and retained v1 printers can show registry v9 documentation. Prior profile versions are overwritten.
Recommended corrective action: Store immutable versioned definitions and stable template IDs; display field-level differences and the exact version each rule/printer actually uses.
Phase1Evidence: U02/U03/U04; P31-P33/P40-P42. Version retention/applied lookup and interval preview corrected; complete diff and legacy template identity remain limited.
Phase3Status: CORRECTED for full diff, immutable versioning and safe opt-in; active changed rules remain pinned and ambiguous legacy mappings blocked

Finding: Global new-task form defaults cumulative baseline to zero
Impact: Without an explicit printerId prop, the first active printer is selected but its hours/prints are not used to initialize baselines. A 900-hour printer receives baseline 0.
Recommended corrective action: Initialize selection and baselines together. Validate against actual usage and ask explicitly for prior service readings when registering used printers.

Finding: Actual usage-based work disappears from calendar/upcoming reports
Impact: No calendar date means occurrences() returns [], even when the hour threshold is already exceeded. Calendar text says these tasks appear at threshold, but they do not.
Recommended corrective action: Provide a truthful undated due-work section/agenda and export it. Only add estimated dates when enough actual reading history exists.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.

Finding: Dashboard KPI/forecast scope is incomplete
Impact: Core arithmetic uses real data, but costs/repairs and requested charts/targets/drill-downs are missing. Undated and overdue tasks are counted under every future horizon; no usage forecasting exists.
Recommended corrective action: Separate workload classes, complete core KPI drill-downs, and resolve basic §9 estimates versus enhanced R2 forecasting scope.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.
Phase2Evidence: U12/S08/S09 pass; other KPIs, forecasts and drill-downs remain outside scope.

Finding: Parts replacement columns do not match their values
Impact: Materials occupy the Usage column while cost is placed under the inherited Cost/parts sequence from a different row schema.
Recommended corrective action: Use explicit typed columns for every report and verify both screen and exported CSV/PDF against fixture totals.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.

Finding: Historical filters depend on current rule metadata
Impact: Changing a current task category/priority or moving its printer changes how past logs are included. Log schema lacks immutable category/priority/profile-version/currency snapshots.
Recommended corrective action: Snapshot historical attribution and define clearly which filters represent historical facts versus current schedule state. Do not rewrite old logs.
Phase1Evidence: U09; P23/P39/P45. New snapshots and honest unknown legacy attribution corrected; historical reconstruction and mixed-currency aggregates remain limited.

Finding: Calendar completed-event filters and adjacent dates are inconsistent
Impact: Completed events only honor printer/date; the grid renders adjoining-month cells but only generates current-month events. Completed events are not actionable buttons.
Recommended corrective action: Filter all event types consistently, generate the entire visible range and allow read-only history detail actions.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.
Phase2Status: PARTIAL — filtering and adjoining cells corrected
Phase2Evidence: U10/S04/S05/B02 pass; unclassified legacy policy explicit; read-only history detail actions remain.

Finding: Printed schedule omits descriptions and has print-theme/layout defects
Impact: A4/Letter contain core metadata but no task descriptions. Dark print background margins and fragmented status/reference columns reduce print friendliness. Only a three-printer one-page case was tested.
Recommended corrective action: Add descriptions, white root/body print surfaces, readable reference layout and long-record/multi-page tests. PNG remains optional feasibility work.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.

Finding: Warning distribution and renewed-consent preview are incomplete
Impact: Full draft and action gate exist. CSV/ICS omit the safety disclaimer; task details lack a full legal link; preview can show restored records before renewed acknowledgment. Qualified legal review is unestablished.
Recommended corrective action: Restrict preview for existing data, carry warnings into all exported schedules and obtain qualified review before a future public launch.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.
Phase4Status: PARTIAL — technical disclosure/consent/export defects corrected; independent Canadian legal review remains NOT VERIFIED

Finding: Contrast and dark-theme surfaces fail the stated accessibility target
Impact: Muted light text: 3.99:1 on white; dark-theme white button label: 2.91:1; dark heading tokens are applied over a still-light page background.
Recommended corrective action: Use theme-aware surfaces and measured foreground pairs. Then audit focus, nested dialogs, screen readers, zoom/reflow and cross-browser behavior.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.
Phase4Status: CORRECTED for documented contrast/surface defects; complete manual accessibility remains NOT VERIFIED

Finding: Notification preferences and OS/browser integrations incomplete or untested
Impact: Single day threshold, no per-type or distinct critical-overdue preferences; notification permission/delivery and configured email-client handoff not verified.
Recommended corrective action: Add per-type controls and isolated integration tests. Preserve truthful closed-app limits; never send feedback automatically.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.

Finding: Early one-time completion is rejected
Impact: For a one-time task, anchorDate is a due date but is validated as a last-service baseline.
Recommended corrective action: Separate due date from baseline or permit valid early completion for one-time tasks.

Finding: Guided steps, unified repair history and richer inventory/reporting remain partial
Impact: No verified step-by-step guided procedure, no repair integration into the printer service timeline, limited recurring-problem analysis and inventory compatibility, no dedicated HTML/PNG schedule export or richer trends.
Recommended corrective action: Keep these visible in the R2 backlog. They do not excuse R1 blockers, and optional/future enhancements are not by themselves an R1 failure.
Phase1Evidence: Original evidence retained; no corrective acceptance claim.
